svg.aria-label: On the 13 Toronto benchmark problems: 78 of 78 runs gave valid timetables; median gap to the best ever published 0.9% (best run); within 1% on 8 of 13; simulated annealing 13% lower penalty than hill climbing in the same time.
svg.title: Benchmark results at a glance

g.text: GAP TO THE BEST EVER PUBLISHED
